reviewer.conflict_declaration: The isolated executors did not implement the reviewed changes and performed read-only verification from fresh public checkouts.

methods: Reviewed the broad security baseline and every security-relevant delta through the exact public revision.
Reproduced the post-initialization runtime path-swap attack and verified rejection before any outside write.
Verified repository-controlled fsmonitor and external diff suppression plus per-invocation Git configuration isolation and cleanup.
Ran the complete governed-runtime suite and inspected the public Linux, macOS and Windows CI matrix at the exact revision.
Checked public CodeQL, clean-room package, conformance, migration, capability, approval, recovery and evidence-boundary results.
Recorded unresolved coverage limits separately from release or production authority.

findings.summary: A symlinked sandbox root could cross the repository boundary.
findings.reproduction: The original adversarial fixture used a symbolic-link sandbox root; the reviewed revision rejects it before adapter access.

findings.summary: Repository Git configuration could invoke fsmonitor or external diff helpers.
findings.reproduction: The adversarial repository config points both helpers at marker commands; the reviewed Git adapter disables them and creates no marker.

findings.summary: A runtime directory replaced by an intermediate symbolic link after initialization allowed an outside read and partial write.
findings.reproduction: The exact attack moves the run subtree outside the runtime home, inserts a symbolic link and calls readRun and appendEvent; both now fail before events or locks are created outside.

findings.summary: Git reads reused one predictable temporary HOME and global configuration path.
findings.reproduction: Instrumentation observed distinct temporary HOME directories for status and diff, exclusive empty configs and cleanup of both directories.

unresolved_risks: The symbolic-link attack probes are POSIX-specific; Windows passed the complete governed-runtime and ordinary Git-read suites but skips those exact fixtures.
The bounded review did not run an open-ended concurrent race campaign between path validation and filesystem calls.
No external human security audit was performed.
No production-write adapter was reviewed or authorized.
attestation: Two isolated AI-assisted executors reviewed the exact public revision, reproduced the corrected attack paths and reported no unresolved critical or high finding.
claim_boundary: This is an owner-authorized isolated AI-assisted review, not an external human audit. It supports production-read release preparation only and cannot authorize production writes, live effects or general production deployment.
